notes: How sure is each player-facing line? Every caption (src/data/captions.json) and journal entry (src/data/journal.json; facts as fact.<n>) has a tag. established: supported by an applied answer in docs/ADVISOR_NOTES.md ('notes:<## heading>', optionally ' > <bold label>') or by published research listed in journal.json's sources ('src:<id>'); refs required. simplified: real biology, squeezed, rounded or simplified for play (timescales, numbers, one cue for many); 'why' says how. device: a game rule, aid or instruction with no claim, or a mechanic the notes leave open; the text must say 'in the game' or stay an instruction. Rule: an instruction to the player may describe the game's rules plainly; a general statement about salmon or their predators that the notes leave open must say 'in the game', 'thought to' or similar. tests/unit/claims.test.ts keeps this file in step with the captions and journal.
